==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I hang up the phone and look at the top of a nearby tower. The tower is shrouded in fog. There appears to be a group of dragons perched on the top of the tower.

I try to get a picture of the dragons, but the fog is too thick and I am too far away. I suddenly fly into the air through the fog. I am determined to get a good picture.

I fly through the fog and appear in a theater. There is a movie playing that I am not meant to see. I hear a group of agents approaching, so I fly out of the theater just as my alarm wakes me up.
